+from rich.live import LiveRender
+from rich.console import Control, ControlType
+
+def test_position_cursor():
+    # Case 1: self._shape is None
+    lr = LiveRender("")
+    lr._shape = None
+    res = lr.position_cursor()
+    print(f"Case 1 (None): {res}")
+
+    # Case 2: height is 0
+    lr._shape = (0, 0)
+    res = lr.position_cursor()
+    print(f"Case 2 (0,0): {res}")
+
+    # Case 3: height is 1
+    lr._shape = (10, 1)
+    res = lr.position_cursor()
+    print(f"Case 3 (10,1): {res}")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_position_cursor()
